cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two biscuits missing. Please don't refill the tin until I've established the weakness in our stock controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. That's the mystery solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The eater is not the weakness. Who issued you two biscuits without recording the withdrawal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. I was hungry and the tin was open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Uncontrolled access and no meal provision. Two separate headings, please. List everyone who can reach that lid; I'll start the catering review.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 stock controls, A3 issuance and A5 separate audit headings correct B small explanation into two larger organisational problems.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 eater identification causes A3 control inquiry; B4 hunger and open lid directly cause A5 catering and access audits.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 try to resolve a mundane missing-biscuit question while A keeps assigning work.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns two B4 ordinary facts into parallel investigations rather than concluding the snack inquiry.

specificity.evidence: A1 two biscuits and B4 open tin establish the disproportion between fact and inference.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 list request and catering review demonstrate expanded scope without the old self-summary.
